lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，第一眼看见你。
lines.en: I came out of the egg and the first thing I saw was you.
Every two steps I nearly fall.

lines.zh: 翅膀还没长好，只能撑一撑。
lines.en: My wings aren't grown. They only break my falls.

lines.zh: 你的靴子往哪走，我就跟哪。
lines.en: Where your boots go, I follow.
Where you go, I go.
I'm a bit heavy. I can't fly yet.

lines.zh: 我扑扇了两下，落到地上。
lines.en: I flap twice and land on the ground.
I get up again and keep walking.
My claws can't grip stone.
I try a bite of grass.

lines.zh: 我咬了口苔藓，又呸出来。
lines.en: I bite some moss and spit it out again.
I look up at you and cry out.
And you stop.
And I catch up.
I crouch at your feet.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，还有点抖。
lines.en: My wings are folded and still trembling.
I'm growing. My bones grow fast.

lines.zh: 我张大嘴打哈欠，牙还小。
lines.en: I yawn wide; my teeth are still small.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，有苹果吗？
lines.en: I stare at your pocket. Apples in there?
There's usually something good in them.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑到你腿边闻。
lines.en: I push my snout to your leg and sniff.
And I shift back again.
I haven't decided.
I rest my head on your shoe.
I knew you from inside the egg.

lines.zh: 你把我从蛋里放出来的。
lines.en: You let me out of the egg.
So you're mine.
Not in that way.
It's another kind of bond.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，跟你一样高。
lines.en: I stretch my neck level with you.

lines.zh: 你一蹲下，我就往你膝盖上爬。
lines.en: The moment you crouch I climb onto your knee.
You touch my head. I don't flinch.
Anyone else would get bitten.
I'm still small.

lines.zh: 我小声叫，尾巴卷了起来。
lines.en: I cry quietly and curl my tail.
I've fallen on my rump.
I lie there and don't get up.
That bent my wing.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，先把翅膀收好。
lines.en: Out of the egg, I first fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我四只脚一撑，爬了起来。
lines.en: I push up on all four feet.

lines.zh: 我躲到你腿后，抖个不停。
lines.en: I hide behind your leg, shaking.
Hiding behind your feet.
You're standing in front of me.
With you here it's all right.
Is that a golden apple?

lines.zh: 这气味，我在蛋里就闻过。
lines.en: I smelled that even inside the egg.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，走得很直。
lines.en: I walk over, very straight.
I open my mouth and wait.
Give it and I'll eat.
When I eat it, I go warm.

lines.zh: 金苹果下肚，鳞片变硬了。
lines.en: The golden apple goes down and my scales harden.
Can you tell?
My horns are longer than yesterday.
Another one, please.
I bump your leg and sit down.
I get up again.
That didn't hurt at all.
I butt your foot with my head.
That's a greeting.
You step back and I step after.

lines.zh: 从我蛋里孵出的手，才认得我。
lines.en: Only the hand that hatched me is my kin.
And I roll to one side.
I lie there looking at you.
I nudge you once and you laugh.
I don't really understand that word.
I only know you're mine.
No one else may touch you.
If they do, I bite.
It doesn't hurt yet.
It will later.

lines.zh: 等我的角长齐，再说这个。
lines.en: Wait until my horns are grown.
My teeth will be big then.

lines.zh: 我还没长大，可别人不能碰你。
lines.en: I am not grown, but no one may touch you.
So for now, this.
I pounce and pin it.
I bite and wrench my head.

lines.zh: 骨头太硬，我的小牙啃不动。
lines.en: That bone is too hard for my small teeth.

lines.zh: 我吐在手心，留着给你看。
lines.en: I spit it into my palm to show you.
This time I carry it steady.
I clamp down on the golden apple.
I carry it off at a run.
Two steps and I fall.
It rolls away.
I lie there, watching it.

lines.zh: 草动了一下，我的头抬起来。
lines.en: The grass stirs and my head comes up.
I press my head to the grass.
I've set my hind legs.
I kick off with my hind legs.
A very good pounce.
And I land badly.
It darts into the grass and is gone.

lines.zh: 我贴着草地，一点一点爬。
lines.en: I hug the grass and creep forward.
Watching it go.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上粘的蛋壳碎片。
lines.en: I shake the eggshell bits off my back.
I get up and try again.
It's closer this time.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，背上还粘着蛋壳。
lines.en: I crouch low, eggshell still stuck to my back.
And edge over.

lines.zh: 那只东西离我只有一尾巴。
lines.en: That thing is a tail's length away.
It stopped and looked back at me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地，一点一点地挪。
lines.en: I hug the ground and creep an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 它看不见我，我藏在石头后。
lines.en: It cannot see me; I am behind the stone.
My claws make no sound.
It has stopped there.

lines.zh: 我也跟着停下，光束还在眼里聚。
lines.en: I stop as well; the beam still gathers in my eyes.
It lowers its head to eat.
I go around behind.
There's a hole in the ground.
I fall in.
It goes into the grass.
I climb out of the hole.
Covered in dirt.

lines.zh: 两道传送门，开在你身后。
lines.en: Two portals open behind you.
Half of it comes off.
I plop down on my rump.
Never mind. No chasing.
With you here I'm not even hungry.
I turn to find you.
You stayed where you were.
I lie at the pit's edge and watch the grass move.
I pounce and bite its tail.
Out of the egg, I bond to you first.
It whips and I go flying.

lines.zh: 蛋壳里滚出来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: Out of the egg, rolling twice.
Up, and pounce again.
This time a leg.
It shrieks with the pain.
The prince's hatchling has sharp teeth.
One flick of its tail and I fly two blocks.

lines.zh: 从蛋里出来，就认你一个。
lines.en: Out of the egg, I know only you.
My mouth is full of fur.
I spit the fur out.
I lunge with my claws leading.
It still got away.
I'm panting, and rather pleased.
Its teeth rake my ear.
The pain makes me let go.
It vanished into the trees.
I sit on the ground and lick my wound.
I know the hand that placed my egg.
A crack opens in the eggshell.
I push from inside.
A piece breaks away.
I put my head out.
It's blindingly bright outside the egg.
I see a hand.
It lifts me up.
I grip it with my claws.
My claws are still soft.
I won't let go for anything.
You set me on the ground.
I can't stand steady on four legs.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里，先叫了一声。
lines.en: From the eggshell I call out first.
This is the one I know.
The fire flares and I hide behind you.

lines.zh: 我从树杈上掉下，翻了个身。
lines.en: I drop from the branch and roll over.

lines.zh: 水进了我的鼻子，我乱扑。
lines.en: Water goes up my nose and I thrash.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，我滚了很远。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I roll a long way.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我，划破了翅膜。
lines.en: An arrow grazes me and tears my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 光把我锁住，翅膀都僵了。
lines.en: The light locks me and my wings stiffen.
I'm hungry and crying loudly.

lines.zh: 雷劈在巢边，我捂住耳朵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes by the nest; I cover my ears.
I fall, and my wings beat at nothing.
